properties.description: Both response valids must be clear following a synchronous reset edge. Reset cancels outstanding scoreboard obligations but does not erase previously recorded alarms.
Every presented output byte, including a blocked presentation, must match the next accepted input prefix in frame order. Only completed short frames justify zero padding.
Every presented output beat must carry the correct final-byte marker for a frame length clamped to four through eight bytes; partial accepted prefixes are supported.

Every presented status must describe the next completed accepted input frame with exact original length, clamped length, padding and truncation flags. Status retirement is independent of data retirement.
A blocked data response must retain valid, byte value and final-byte marker across the next edge unless that edge resets the controller.
A blocked status response must retain valid and all four status fields across the next edge unless that edge resets the controller.
